limits: The earlier TLS-GCM-to-rollover log interval includes preceding grant and cancellation checks; it does not measure only the 512 entropy requests. New standalone elapsed receipts bound the dedicated probe from parent observation.
The failed original composition remains failed. Separate probes do not satisfy the former combined 45-second assertion; combined wall-clock allowance is larger.
Every rollover request still uses the production service-only owned client under one 30-second deadline. No accepted request replay, kernel scheduling change or invalidation change is included.
No attribution of the historical root 157:8/object 35194 retirement-pin failure; expected early injected retention diagnostics are not that failure.
Finite concurrent cancellation and host checks do not qualify sustained fairness, aggregate pressure or physical hardware.
Probe elapsed receipts include startup/grant and concurrent cancellation work. Different CPU/IOMMU configurations are not an isolated performance benchmark.
